notes.phytoprotection_substance: Pyrethrin (organic-approved) for aphid, whitefly, and thrips control on peppers. Potassium bicarbonate for powdery mildew prevention. Sulfur-based products for broad-spectrum fungal protection.
notes.phytoprotection_application: Apply pyrethrin in the evening when beneficial insects are less active. Reapply after rain. For powdery mildew, begin potassium bicarbonate applications preventively when conditions favor disease development.
